verdict.rationale: Brex's own materials describe 'global corporate cards' and service in '120+ countries', which supports spending abroad on a company card. Nothing in the pack addresses foreign transaction fees or cash withdrawals, so the core 'no hidden foreign fees' promise is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented absence of foreign transaction/FX fees, ATM cash withdrawal support abroad, FX rate transparency, independent or hands-on corroboration.
